Last week, Apple filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, accusing a former employee of stealing trade secrets "for OpenAI's benefit."

According to reports, during the lawsuit proceedings, Apple has directly contacted several former employees who currently work at OpenAI.

According to the Financial Times, Apple has issued evidence preservation notices to approximately 40 former employees.

An evidence preservation notice is a formal written notice sent to an individual or organization, requiring them to preserve documents, records, and other evidence that may be relevant to a legal dispute. Such notices typically clearly specify the exact materials that must be preserved.

This move suggests Apple suspects trade secret theft may extend beyond the individuals named in last week's lawsuit.

A recap: Apple's lawsuit names OpenAI and io Products as defendants, while also naming former Apple employees Chang Liu and Tang Tan.
